bio: I design and build both the part you see and the part you don't: websites, custom systems and everything behind them.
I make sure what was promised in the proposal is what reaches production, fast and done right.
I work with data and AI so your business does fewer repetitive tasks and decides with better information.
Automations and models that solve concrete problems, explained without jargon.
